blocks.text: LUCENA CITY, Quezon — The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) suspended small-vessel operations in northern Quezon on Wednesday afternoon, Oct. 21, as rough seas generated by Super Typhoon Rosal threatened sea travel. In a public advisory, the PCG station in Real, Quezon, cited the 5 p.m. weather bulletin issued by the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), which warned that strong to gale-force winds were expected to affect the northern and eastern coasts of Polillo Island, including the northern coasts of Panukulan and Burdeos and the eastern coasts of Patnanungan and Jomalig.
